sections.title: Species traits
lines: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Badger hybrid. Constitution +2. Walk 20 ft. and burrow 10 ft.
Badger animal form. Tiny, walk 30 ft., burrow 10 ft., AC 15. Str 8, Dex 17, Con 15. Natural attack damage: two claws 1d2−1 and bite 1d3−1.

sections.title: Original NPC · Seki
lines: Badger example. Cave surveyor and rescue contact.
Motive. Confirm which shaft can still support the weight of trapped workers.
Hook. Seki will inspect a narrow support passage if the party keeps the main shaft clear.
Badger Hengeyokai cave surveyor, Expert 1 · Provisional CR 1/2. ECL 2. · Medium Shapechanger
AC 12 · HP 5 (1d6+1) · Speed Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and burrow 10 ft.

sections.title: Original NPC · Aya
lines: Sparrow example. Dispatch runner and lookout.
Motive. Get a warning to the next watch post before a washout cuts off the main road.
Hook. Aya can look ahead by air and needs someone to keep the lower footpath open for travelers.
Sparrow Hengeyokai dispatch runner, Rogue 1 · Provisional CR 1. ECL 2. · Medium Shapechanger
AC 13 · HP 5 (1d6+1) · Speed Human 30 ft., hybrid 20 ft. and fly 20 ft. (average)

sections.title: Species traits
lines: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Rat hybrid. Dexterity +2. +4 Hide.
Rat animal form. Tiny, walk 15 ft., climb 15 ft., AC 14. Str 2, Dex 15, Con 10. Natural attack damage: bite 1d3−4.

sections.title: Species traits
lines: A playable shapechanger with three forms: human, animal, and bipedal hybrid. Choose one animal kind. A character keeps that animal kind and its corresponding hybrid throughout play.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Crane hybrid. Dexterity +2. Walk 20 ft. and fly 20 ft. (average).
Crane animal form. Small, walk 5 ft., fly 60 ft., AC 14. Str 6, Dex 16, Con 10. Natural attack damage: bite 1d4−2.

The 2002 errata supplies average maneuverability for hybrid flight. The 2003 FAQ describes hands at the wing ends. In flight, carry only light weapons or objects of up to 6 lb, and no shield or buckler.

Original D&D 3.0: Wisdom −2, Shapechanger type, and level adjustment +1. Humanoid-only effects such as charm person and hold person do not apply, but shapechanger effects do. The published setting places Hengeyokai outside Rokugan.
Human form is Medium, has a 30-ft. land speed, and uses the character’s generated physical ability scores.

Alternate Form is supernatural. Each transition uses one of 1 + actual character level uses per day. It takes a full round and provokes attacks of opportunity. The original printing references the D&D 3.0 polymorph rules.

Animal form uses the fixed size, physical scores, movement, AC, and natural damage below. Merged gear and magic items are unavailable. A +10 circumstance bonus applies to Disguise checks in animal form.
Animal and hybrid forms have low-light vision and can communicate with their own animal kind. The 2003 FAQ confirms Medium hybrids. Apply the hybrid adjustment to current physical scores.
Gear stays intact between human and hybrid forms and reappears after leaving animal form. A hybrid typically uses light or medium armor. Heavy armor is unavailable in hybrid form.
Automatic languages Common and Hengeyokai. Bonus languages Giant, Goblin, Nezumi, and Spirit Tongue. Favored class Wu jen.
Level adjustment affects experience and starting equipment. A first-level Hengeyokai has ECL 2 but still has two form changes per day.
Cat hybrid. Dexterity +2. +4 on Balance checks.
Cat animal form. Tiny, walk 30 ft., AC 14. Str 3, Dex 15, Con 10. Natural attack damage: two claws 1d2−4 and bite 1d3−4.
